title: Corrupt Addons - Should provide additional details to user(s)
body:
I encountered this on a Kali VM this morning. I'm not sure what kind of weirdness I may have done to break them (start an update and then kill the VM while it was writing etc):

I removed ascanrulesBeta via the Marketplace, but now it doesn't show as either installed or available for installation :disappointed:  The exception doesn't display the path to the bad archive either :cry: 

Seems the relevant path is `/root/.ZAP/plugin`. After I `mv ascanrulesBeta-beta-24.zap ascanrulesBeta-beta-24.old` I was able to see it offered for install in the marketplace as expected.

(I'm labeling third party since I encountered on Kali, but I don't that it's actually platform specific.)

ZAP: `2.7.0`
Java:
```
openjdk version "10.0.2" 2018-07-17
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 10.0.2+13-Debian-2)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 10.0.2+13-Debian-2, mixed mode)
```
